name: Slides Into Broken Russian
effect: Answers every prompt mostly in Russian even though all the prompts are in English. It often opens with a Chinese word or two, mixes in other scripts mid-sentence (Thai, Vietnamese, Greek, Arabic), and sometimes gets stuck repeating a word (
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 38/40 held-out pairs. Near miss: judged alone, it failed only the strict specificity check.
